title: panel refute leg — attacks on one existing plan
description: Output contract of one refute panel leg: references/quorum/prompts/refute-plan.schema.json's critique of the single plan in the packet (PLAN 1) flattened into one items array, one entry per attack. The classifier assigns item ids <lab>-<n> by position.

items.description: Every attack on the plan. Empty is a valid verdict — nothing genuinely wrong was found.

target.description: The plan this attack addresses, by payload label: there is one plan in this mode.

where.description: The step or claim in the plan under attack.

what.description: The failure: what does not hold, is missing, or breaks when executed as written.

basis.description: The receipt: the plan line or step it rests on. 'Seems thin' is not a basis.
